title: PIRIN EXTREME 38K - race day

steps.target: Z2-Z3, hike the steep climbs, controlled descents

coachNotes: The day you trained for. Start conservative - first climb at conversational effort, you pass people later. Fuel 70-90g carbs/h from minute one, drink to thirst plus electrolytes. Poles for the big climbs and descents. Registration and kit check are FRIDAY 13:00-20:00 in Bansko, mandatory medical check, be there.
